sources.magnet: STM32 USART1 application uses 115200 8N1 commands and a 50..500 ms timed MAGNET_ON lease. The by-id path ending 5B7A030191 is user-provided deployment data and must be rechecked on Jetson. Production sequence is pick-duration-elapsed -> MAGNET_ON/status-confirm -> release-duration-elapsed -> MAGNET_OFF/status-confirm. physical_pick_verified remains false until post-move visual evidence.
sources.motion: The first controller write after opening and read-only handshake is the direct HOME set_pose command; Q1 does not send CMD_SET_GLOBAL_ACC. Each pose advances after its configured 6000 ms duration because current NexArm coordinate/servo feedback is stale during confirmed physical motion.

_note: Single active source for NexArm, camera and STM32 magnet endpoints, arm calibration, HOME, motion and planning parameters. Production Q1 is STM32-only; real energization still requires --confirm RUN_Q1. The main sequence uses configured pose durations instead of stale NexArm arrival feedback.
